description: Search Haraj (haraj.com.sa) by keyword, browse by category/city, look up listings by ID or URL, pull all active listings or the profile of a seller, or fetch trending search keywords.

authorUsername.description: Haraj seller display name, @handler, or a full https://haraj.com.sa/users/... URL. Required for mode=byAuthor (all listings) and mode=seller (profile).
authorUsername.title: Seller / store username or URL (mode=byAuthor, seller)

carBodyType.description: Restrict results to a specific car body style (mode=search, browse). Haraj's own frontend uses this exact 12-value vocabulary as a hidden filter axis, distinct from `subTag`'s brand/model tags — confirmed via live probing that each value reliably narrows to the correct body style server-side. Since only one tag value can be sent upstream at a time, this takes priority over `subTag`/`category` for that slot when set (both still apply as extra client-side checks afterwards). Leave as "(any body type)" for no filter.
carBodyType.title: Car body type

carCondition.description: Only keep car listings in this condition (client-side over Haraj's structured car info). Listings without the attribute are skipped.
carCondition.title: Car condition

category.description: Restrict results to a Haraj top-level category (mode=search, browse). Jobs (وظائف) is included; leave as "(any category)" for no category filter.
category.title: Category

cities.description: Restrict results to any of several Saudi cities/regions (or Kuwait, UAE, Bahrain) in one request — a listing matching ANY selected city passes (mode=search, browse). Combines with `city` above (both are OR'd together) if both are set. Leave empty for no multi-city filter.
cities.title: Multiple cities / regions

city.description: Restrict results to a Saudi city/region (or Kuwait, UAE, Bahrain) (mode=search, browse). "عسير" is accepted as an alias of "أبها" (the value Haraj returns). Leave as "(any city)" for no city filter.
city.title: City / region

excludeCategory.description: Drop results from this category, even if they match other filters (mode=search, browse).
excludeCategory.title: Exclude category

fuelType.description: Only keep car listings with this fuel type (client-side). Listings without the attribute are skipped.
fuelType.title: Fuel type

hideShowRooms.description: Exclude listings from dealer/store-type sellers (e.g. car-parts shops, showroom accounts), keeping only individual sellers (mode=search, browse — Haraj's seller-listings endpoint doesn't support this filter).
hideShowRooms.title: Hide dealer / store showroom listings

includeComments.description: Add a `comments[]` array (author, body, date, reply info) to every listing. One request per listing page; slow for large runs.
includeComments.title: Include comments

includeLikeCounts.description: Add `likeCount` to every listing using Haraj's public likes endpoint. One extra request per listing.
includeLikeCounts.title: Include like counts

includeSeller.description: Attach a compact `seller` object to every listing (username, seller URL, store type, public store phone numbers, rating, verified badges, coordinates). Adds up to two requests per distinct seller.
includeSeller.title: Include seller / store profile

includeSimilarListings.description: For each resolved listing, attach a `similarListings[]` array of related Haraj listings (id, title, url, priceSAR, thumbnailUrl, city) using Haraj's own "related items" lookup. Adds one extra request per listing ID, so only available for mode=byId.
includeSimilarListings.title: Include similar listings (mode=byId)

is4WD.description: Only keep car listings marked as four-wheel drive (client-side).
is4WD.title: Only four-wheel drive

maxCommentsPerListing.description: When `includeComments` is enabled, stop after this many comments per listing.
maxCommentsPerListing.title: Max comments per listing

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. Haraj's own pagination exposes roughly 300 unique listings per unfiltered query before it starts repeating; narrow queries may return fewer than this cap. Set `splitByCity` to run the same query per region and collect more.
maxItems.title: Max items

mileageMaxKm.description: Only keep car listings at or below this mileage in kilometres (client-side).
mileageMaxKm.title: Maximum mileage (km)

mileageMinKm.description: Only keep car listings at or above this mileage in kilometres (client-side over Haraj's structured car info).
mileageMinKm.title: Minimum mileage (km)

mode.description: What to fetch. `seller` returns one seller/store profile; the other modes return listings (or trending keywords).
enumTitles: Lookup listings by ID or URL
mode.title: Mode

modelYearMax.description: Only keep car listings from this model year or older (client-side).
modelYearMax.title: Maximum model year

modelYearMin.description: Only keep car listings from this model year or newer (client-side).
modelYearMin.title: Minimum model year

neighborhood.description: Restrict results to an exact match of Haraj's finer town/neighbourhood-level location tag (the `geoCity` output field) — e.g. `الدرعية` (Diriyah) or `الخبر` (Al Khobar). More granular than `city`/`cities` (which match the broader region) and combines with them as an AND. Free-text because Haraj's town list runs into the hundreds and isn't a stable curated set — enter the exact value from a listing's own `geoCity` output field (mode=search, browse, byAuthor).
neighborhood.title: Neighborhood / town (fine-grained location)

onlyWithImage.description: Skip listings that have no photos.
onlyWithImage.title: Only listings with images

onlyWithPrice.description: Skip listings where the seller did not state a price.
onlyWithPrice.title: Only listings with a stated price

onlyWithVideo.description: Skip listings that have no video.
onlyWithVideo.title: Only listings with video

postIds.description: Haraj numeric listing IDs or full listing URLs, e.g. `186610241` or `https://haraj.com.sa/11186610241/...`. Required for this mode.
postIds.title: Listing IDs or URLs (mode=byId)

postedWithin.description: Only keep listings posted within this window (mode=search, browse; also applied client-side for byAuthor).
postedWithin.title: Posted within

priceMax.description: Drop listings priced above this (SAR). Listings with no price stated always pass through.
priceMax.title: Max price (SAR)

priceMin.description: Drop listings priced below this (SAR). Listings with no price stated always pass through.
priceMin.title: Min price (SAR)

searchQuery.description: Free-text keyword search, in Arabic or English (mode=search). Required for this mode.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sellOrWaiver.description: Only keep car listings that are sold outright or offered as a lease transfer (client-side). Listings without the attribute are skipped.
sellOrWaiver.title: Sale or lease transfer

splitByCity.description: Run the same search/browse query once per Saudi region and merge/dedupe the results. This gets past Haraj's ~300-row window for a single query. Ignored when `city` or `cities` is set. Adds one query per region, so it is slower.
splitByCity.title: Split search across cities (get more results)

subTag.description: Narrower than `category` — a specific brand or model tag from Haraj's own hierarchical tag tree, e.g. `تويوتا` (Toyota), `كامري` (Camry), `ايفون` (iPhone) (mode=search, browse). Confirmed via live probing that Haraj's finer tags filter correctly server-side, but the full tag tree runs into the thousands (every brand/model/variant across every category) so it isn't a stable curated dropdown — enter the exact tag text, e.g. copied from a listing's own `categories[]` output field. When set, this takes priority over `category` for narrowing (only one tag value can be sent upstream at a time) — `category`/`excludeCategory` still apply as an extra check afterwards.
subTag.title: Brand / model / sub-category tag

transmission.description: Only keep car listings with this transmission (client-side). Listings without the attribute are skipped.
transmission.title: Transmission

trendingRangeDays.description: How many trailing days of search activity to rank trending keywords over. Haraj's public trending-keywords endpoint only has data for 1-14 days.
trendingRangeDays.title: Trending window in days (mode=trending)

title: Haraj Scraper Input
